sections.title: Average private rents rose in Manchester
sections.content: The average monthly private rent in Manchester was £1,373 in August 2026. This was an increase from £1,317 in August 2025, a 4.2% rise.

By how many bedrooms there are in a property, average rents as of August 2026 in Manchester were:

  • One bedroom: £1,003
  • Two bedrooms: £1,233
  • Three bedrooms: £1,433
  • Four or more bedrooms: £2,014

Taking the data instead by property type, average rents were:

  • Flats and maisonettes: £1,147
  • Terraced properties: £1,405
  • Semi-detached properties: £1,496
  • Detached properties: £1,878

We also publish private rental affordability for local areas in England and Wales, comparing rents to household incomes.
